disagreements.title: Berth cards have no card-level selected or focus state
disagreements.a_reason: Selection and focus are both shown, by the 24 px native radio dot and its focus ring; extending the highlight to the whole card is a design preference, and the finding shows no skipper being misled about which berth is chosen.
disagreements.b_reason: Genuine but minor: on large option cards the chosen berth is signalled only by the small native radio while the card's hover border looks like a selection cue, so a skipper can be unsure which berth is chosen or proceed with the wrong one, and keyboard users track a small ring rather than the card.

disagreements.title: Tide table headers misaligned with right-aligned times
disagreements.a_reason: Genuine comprehension risk in a safety-relevant table: at 1280 the 'Afternoon' header sits nearer the right-aligned morning figures than its own, so a high-water time can be read against the wrong column. Not seeded.
disagreements.b_reason: Cosmetic alignment: the two columns hold 24-hour times that are unmistakably morning and afternoon, so a skipper cannot misread which is which; no effect on the task.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
